name: Karazhan Catacombs
summary: The Karazhan Catacombs are an expansive subterranean network carved beneath the foundations of Medivh's ancient tower in Deadwind Pass. Cloaked in dark magical residue and ominous silence, the vaults serve as the secluded base of operations for the mysterious Dark Riders and hoard countless stolen artifacts.

sections.title: The Vaults Beneath the Tower
sections.body: Burrowed deep into the bedrock of Deadwind Pass directly below the tower of Karazhan, these cavernous catacombs are entered through an iron gate near the structure's base. The subterranean chambers mirror the strange, reality-bending aura of Medivh's former home. Long isolated from the rest of the kingdom, the winding corridors hold damp vaults, restless phantasms, and ancient masonry, all shadowed by the lingering taint of the Guardian's tragic fall.

sections.title: Lair of the Dark Riders
sections.body: The catacombs have gained a sinister reputation as the primary refuge of the Dark Riders—the spectral, hooded figures that terrorize nearby Duskwood and Deadwind Pass. Led by Ariden, these grim hunters ride across the countryside in search of powerful, ancient relics to drag back into the darkness. Within these halls lie stockpiles of stolen armaments, cursed curiosities, and enigmatic artifacts hoarded away from the eyes of the living world.

faq.answer: They are a massive network of underground chambers and vaults resting directly beneath the tower of Karazhan in Deadwind Pass, accessible via a gated entrance at the tower's base.
The catacombs primarily harbor the Dark Riders, their shadowy steeds, and wandering phantasms and cursed guardians tethered to the tower's restless magical currents.

faq.q: Why do the Dark Riders gather here?
aliases: what do dark riders do here
faq.answer: The Dark Riders use the remote, spell-cloaked halls as a secure sanctuary and treasury, bringing relics and artifacts plundered from travelers across the Eastern Kingdoms into the deep chambers.

faq.q: Is this the same place as the Forgotten Crypt?
faq.answer: No. The catacombs sit directly beneath the tower itself, while the infamous Forgotten Crypt lies nearby beneath the graveyard of Morgan's Plot.

angles.text: For practitioners of the arcane, the catacombs thrum with volatile residual energy and the eerie magical fallout of Medivh's doomed reign as Guardian.
The artifacts hauled into these subterranean vaults are often plundered from innocent travelers and homesteads across Duskwood and Stormwind's southern reaches.
